title_en: Character Riddles (14/20): An Eye on a Tree
note_en: 相 is a 多音字, a character with more than one reading: xiāng means "mutually," as in 互相, 相信 and 相亲, while xiàng means "appearance," as in 照相, 真相 and 首相. English has a few words like this ("read" now vs. "read" yesterday), but in Chinese only the context tells you which reading, and which tone, to use.
